summary: North kerb backing onto dense bush; cars park on this street, nearest home 40 m+.

drivers.seclusion: Dense canopy behind the kerb; only school buildings 39 m or more away, houses further east.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, easy access; north edge looks narrow beside bush, so room to pull off is uncertain.
drivers.traffic: Moderate local and school traffic; power lines run along the south side.
drivers.convention: Many cars park on the south kerb; signs here are a school loading zone, handled by the sign screen.

flags: Slightly steep: about 3% grade, falling east to west
Low-lying: 14.5 m, Witton Creek 5 m away
School drop-off activity at peak times
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tree canopy, mostly from the north side.
cannot_judge: Width of verge on north side

best_section.where: Western end of the north kerb, beside the bushy block opposite parked cars
